subject: d_ply: using the values of .variables to label plots

messages.author: 7cb65577bc9b60a6
messages.subject: d_ply: using the values of .variables to label plots
parts:
Greetings all,

I have a data frame structured like this:

d <- data.frame(yvar = rep(1:3, 2), varName = (rep(letters[1:2],
each=3)), xvals = rnorm(6))
d

and I want to plot the "yva"r versus "xvals" on separate pages for
each "varName", but I'd also like a title at the top of each plot
which identifies the "varName". In other words I want something like
this with the current value of ".variables" in the d_ply function to
be inserted instead of the string "what" in myFun:

myFun <- function(d) {
p1 <- ggplot(data=d, aes(x=xvals, y=yvar)) + geom_point()
p1 + opts(title="what")
}


pdf("trial.pdf")
d_ply(d, .(varName), .fun=myFun, .print=TRUE)
dev.off()

Any suggestions? (I'll spare you my unsuccessful attempts!)

Cheers,

Leon Barmuta
